svg.title: Watchman: Plunderspell bestiary concept sheet

text.tspan: Walks a fixed route carrying the only light in a dark room. Unarmoured
and slow to react; you avoid him, you don't fight him.
A household servant on night rounds, not a soldier: rough wool tunic, a
Horn lantern with a four-post frame, carried low. The tallow flame is
the only warm light in the scene.
Oak staff for balance and knocking on doors, not a weapon he'd draw.
Tired and bored, three hours into a shift: heavy lids, stubble, a slight

svg.text: the flame only: the scene's one warm accent

text.tspan: Madder: None: he's the calm before it.
